Subject: Archival/deletion evidence request for ClearHarbor tenant

Hi Ben —

TrustAudits is running the quarterly SOC 2 evidence pull for ClearHarbor (CHB-9872). They need the following artifacts related to data residency, retention, and deletion for the tenant:

- A copy of the retention/archival policy that applied to CHB in production during Sep–Oct 2026
- Manifest of objects moved to archival storage (bucket + prefix + timestamps) for the last 90 days
- Audit logs showing the deletion event(s) for user accounts and confirmed erasure of tenant-scoped artifacts (index, backups, KV cache entries)
- Process doc or runbook showing how deletions are executed and any support tickets/approvals associated with retention overrides

Please provide these as downloadable attachments or links by COB Wed 2026-10-14. If you have a primary contact on the infra side, please loop them in.

Thanks,

Thanks Ben — I pulled the artifacts and attached a short export. Summary of what I'm including here:

1) retention-policy-2026.pdf — the active retention & archival policy for hosted tenants (text excerpt highlights CHB-specific override dated 2026-03-01).
2) s3-archive-manifest-CHB-20261010.csv — per-object manifest for the CHB archival prefix covering 2026-07-10 through 2026-10-10 (columns: key, size, storage_class, moved_at).
3) deletion-trace-CHB-user-44123.log.gz — compressed log excerpt for an example user deletion workflow executed 2026-10-10T02:12:43Z (shows job id, DB row removal, KV cache purge, backup tombstone).
4) docsign-ack-CHB-9872.pdf — signed retention override approval (redacted PII).

Notes and controls:
- Deletions initiated via the tenant admin UI create a deletion-job id in our orchestration layer (job id included in the log). That job triggers coordinated steps: mark tenant as "deleting" in metadata DB -> submit background worker deletion job -> S3 lifecycle transition of snapshots -> final object deletion jobs (with tombstone markers).
- We maintain an append-only deletion audit feed (internal Kafka topic) that is retained 90 days and exported on demand; the feed includes job ids and timestamps. For long-term forensic pulls we can provide the feed slice for CHB on request.
- Where cryptographic erasure is used (ephemeral cache), we include key rotation/KMS events in the log. KMS event ids are present in the exported log.

Link to secure Drive package (expires 7 days): https://drive.redwood.example.com/records/CHB-9872/archival-evidence

If you need full raw S3 server access logs, we will coordinate with infra but note those are large and we may provide scoped slices.

Irene Choi
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

Irene — this is great, thank you. A couple follow-ups after a preliminary review:

- For scope, we need a confirmation that the manifest includes cross-region replicas (ClearHarbor is concerned about EU residency for a subset of accounts). Can you confirm whether any CHB objects were replicated to eu-west-1 during the period? If so, we need the replica timestamps.
- For the deletion-trace: please include the deletion-job id in the subject line or top of the log excerpt so our team can map it to the audit ID. The example log looks like it contains the job id but it's not obvious in the compressed extract.

If you can add a short note answering those two points in the same Drive package, we'll mark this item as satisfied.

Samantha
